Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

internet — the world network of computers. Example: I search for information on the internet.
online — connected to the internet. Example: I am online two hours a day.
website — a set of pages on the internet. Example: I visit two websites every day.
email — a message you send by computer. Example: I check my email every morning.
search — to look for information. Example: I search for news online.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I check my email.
• I search for information.
• I visit a website.
• I am online every day.
• It is on the internet.
